name: Oak Curriculum Ontology (RDF/OWL/SKOS curriculum data KS1-4, aligned to 2014 National Curriculum)
evidence_quote: The curriculum ontology, vocabulary definitions, and curriculum data are licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. (applies to ontology/, data/, docs/; code is MIT)
what_it_gives_us: Machine-readable programme structure, units, threads, knowledge taxonomies per subject/key stage (e.g. data/subjects/mathematics/mathematics-key-stage-1..4.ttl) aligned to the National Curriculum. Best single backbone for a curriculum graph.
recommendation: ADOPT as primary curriculum spine. Attribute Oak + OGL v3. Note README: 'Oak-developed representation and does not constitute an official DfE National Curriculum publication.'

name: Oak National Academy lessons, units, quizzes via Oak Curriculum API
evidence_quote: Lesson content published after 1st September 2022 hosted on www.thenational.academy is made available under an Open Government Licence (OGL) v3.0, except where otherwise stated.
what_it_gives_us: Lesson plans, key learning points, misconceptions, keywords, quizzes, worksheets, slide decks. API code repos: oaknational/oak-curriculum-api (MIT code; README: 'Curriculum content served through the API ... is not covered by this repository's licence'), oaknational/oak-open-curriculum-ecosystem (SDK/MCP). npm: @oaknational/oak-curriculum-schema (schema only).
github_repo_if_any: oaknational/oak-curriculum-api, oaknational/oak-open-curriculum-ecosystem, oaknational/Oak-Web-Application (all ls-remote OK) - code only, not content
recommendation: ADOPT (content needs API key / thenational.academy, blocked here). Exclude third-party-copyright items (API gates them; see src/lib/queryGate.ts). Required attribution: 'A [subject] lesson by Oak National Academy licensed under Open Government Licence (OGL)'. Pre-Sept-2022 content not OGL.

name: National curriculum in England: framework for KS1-4 and programmes of study
evidence_quote: This publication is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
what_it_gives_us: Statutory programme-of-study statements (the canonical objectives to tag everything against), plus English spelling/grammar appendices.
recommendation: ADOPT as the authoritative objective list; much is already mirrored in the Oak ontology.

name: Mathematics guidance: key stages 1 and 2 (Ready-to-Progress criteria)
evidence_quote: This publication (not including logos) is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
what_it_gives_us: Ready-to-progress criteria (e.g. 3NPV-1) per year group, core concepts, example assessment questions, fluency expectations.
recommendation: ADOPT; high-value progression spine for primary maths. Quote came via search summary + DERA record (dera.ioe.ac.uk/id/eprint/35896) - verify PDF imprint page on download.

name: Mathematics guidance: key stage 3 (Teaching mathematics at key stage 3, Sept 2021)
evidence_quote: This publication (not including logos) is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
what_it_gives_us: Year 7-9 ordering of key mathematical ideas per strand with exemplification; plus 'Sample Key Stage 3 Mathematics Curriculum Framework' PDF.
recommendation: ADOPT. Licence statement is the standard gov.uk imprint; not seen verbatim in snippets for this specific PDF - verify on download (DERA eprint 38609).

name: NCETM materials (Mastery PD materials, primary spine materials, assessment materials, checkpoints)
publisher: NCETM (operated by Etio / Tribal Group for DfE)
evidence_quote: Unless otherwise stated the content of this website is subject to Crown Copyright (now superseded by the Open Government Licence).
what_it_gives_us: Spine small-steps, mastery PD slides, checkpoints/assessment items, representations.
recommendation: CAUTION. Site statement implies OGL but the same page also says to acknowledge source and, where an author is named, 'contact the author and obtain their permission'. Many resources carry their own notices. Use the DfE-hosted NCETM-authored guidance (KS1-2, KS3) instead; seek written confirmation from NCETM before ingesting spine/PD materials.

name: The reading framework (July 2023, updated 2025)
evidence_quote: This publication is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
what_it_gives_us: Principles of SSP, decodable text guidance, fluency, reading for pleasure, older-reader support; GPC progression guidance.
recommendation: ADOPT for teacher-facing guidance. Standard gov.uk imprint; search summary confirmed OGL but verify exact wording on PDF imprint page.

name: Letters and Sounds: principles and practice of high quality phonics (2007)
evidence_quote: DERA record: document available under the Open Government Licence (some content in later versions redacted due to third-party rights)
what_it_gives_us: Phase 1-6 GPC sequence, high-frequency/tricky word lists, phonics activities - useful for decodable word lists and phase tagging.
recommendation: USE WITH CARE: Crown copyright, OGL per DERA listing (quote paraphrased from search summary, not verbatim). No longer a DfE-validated SSP programme - use as data (phase/GPC lists), not as a 'programme'. Skip any redacted third-party images.

name: Teach Computing Curriculum (KS1-KS4 units, lesson plans, slides, assessments)
publisher: Raspberry Pi Foundation for the National Centre for Computing Education
evidence_quote: This resource is licensed under the Open Government Licence, version 3. For more information on this licence, see ncce.io/ogl.
what_it_gives_us: ~500 hours of units: learning objectives, success criteria, lesson plans, slides, summative assessments (multiple-choice quizzes) and rubrics.
github_repo_if_any: none found (tried raspberrypilearning/, RaspberryPiFoundation/, NCCE/ teach-computing-curriculum - all failed)
recommendation: ADOPT; best open computing source. Download zips from teachcomputing.org manually. Check per-unit third-party images.

name: Isaac Computer Science (GCSE + A level CS content and questions)
publisher: Raspberry Pi Foundation / University of Cambridge (NCCE)
evidence_quote: All teaching materials on this site are available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated.
what_it_gives_us: Topic concept pages and auto-marked question bank for GCSE computer science (KS4).
github_repo_if_any: isaaccomputerscience/isaac-api, isaac-react-app (Apache-2.0 code, ls-remote OK); isaaccomputerscience/isaac-code-samples (ls-remote OK but CC BY-SA 4.0 - EXCLUDE). No public content repo found.
recommendation: ADOPT GCSE content (not reachable from sandbox). Do NOT use isaac-code-samples (BY-SA).

name: Isaac Physics / Isaac Science
evidence_quote: All materials on Isaac Science are licensed under the Creative Commons license unless stated otherwise ... Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International License
github_repo_if_any: isaacphysics/isaac-api, isaacphysics/isaac-react-app (ls-remote OK, code only); no content repo found

name: STA key stage 1/2 test frameworks (content domain references e.g. 2a-2h reading, 3C1 maths)
evidence_quote: This publication is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
what_it_gives_us: Content domain codes and descriptors - ideal tagging schema for question items; cognitive domain; test specification.
recommendation: ADOPT; use content-domain codes as item metadata. Search summary confirmed OGL v3 for reading, maths and GPS frameworks.

name: STA KS1/KS2 national curriculum test papers, sample materials and mark schemes
evidence_quote: All other materials in the test booklets are Crown copyright, and may be re-used (not including logos) free of charge in any format or medium in accordance with the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0. ... 'Contains material developed by the Standards and Testing Agency for [year] national curriculum assessments and licensed under Open Government Licence v3.0'
what_it_gives_us: Real calibrated items + mark schemes for maths arithmetic/reasoning and GPS; reading questions.
recommendation: ADOPT maths and GPS items with required attribution. EXCLUDE reading texts/images listed in the yearly 'copyright ownership' report (third-party) unless licensed.

name: DfE GCSE subject content and assessment objectives
evidence_quote: This publication is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
what_it_gives_us: KS4 content statements (incl. foundation/higher split for maths) and AO weightings.
recommendation: ADOPT as KS4 objective list. Exam-board specs/past papers are NOT OGL - exclude.

name: Ofqual conditions, guidance and subject-level requirements
evidence_quote: This publication is licensed under the terms of the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
what_it_gives_us: Subject-level conditions (e.g. maths formulae given/not given, assessment rules), grading descriptors.
recommendation: ADOPT selectively (formula sheets, grade descriptors) - low content value otherwise.

name: Project Gutenberg texts (via GITenberg GitHub mirror)
evidence_quote: You can do anything you want with Project Gutenberg texts in the United States without permission ... if you are not located in the United States, you will have to check the laws of the country where you are located
what_it_gives_us: Classic texts (Carroll, Burnett, Dickens, Stevenson, Shakespeare) for reading passages; many are GCSE set texts.
github_repo_if_any: GITenberg/Alice-s-Adventures-in-Wonderland_11 and GITenberg/The-Secret-Garden_113 (ls-remote OK; one repo per book, mirror is dated); pgcorpus/gutenberg (tool, ls-remote OK)
recommendation: USE per-work: only texts whose authors died >70 years ago (UK public domain). Strip PG header/footer and do not use the 'Project Gutenberg' trademark. Not a licence per se - underlying works are public domain in UK case by case.

name: BBC Bitesize
evidence_quote: No open licence found; BBC content terms permit personal, non-commercial use only (search did not surface Bitesize-specific verbatim text).

name: White Rose Maths / White Rose Education schemes of learning
evidence_quote: No open licence found; White Rose owns the copyright and trademarks; premium resources require paid subscription (search summary).
what_it_gives_us: Nothing reusable (free for schools to use, not to republish).
recommendation: EXCLUDE. Do not replicate small-steps wording.
